policy.ambiguousLock: REFUSED with a named operator action
policy.liveHolderEviction: liveness only; an indeterminate answer counts as a holder
policy.deadHolderEviction: AUTOMATIC — a crashed worker frees capacity without operator action
policy.criticalSection: the lock is held only across the read-modify-write of the holder record
policy.failedRelease: retryable, and `held` stays true until the reduced record is durably written
policy.unreadableRecord: never rewritten; the bytes are preserved and the refusal is observable
